title: Ambiguous Shipment Candidates
description: Two candidate shipments exist for the same invoice and item. The signed receipt does not reference a specific shipment ID, creating an unresolved match.

dispute.message: We received only 50 units for invoice INV-2026-003, but two shipments were dispatched around the same time and we cannot identify which one this applies to.

expected_findings.statement: Multiple candidate shipments (SHP-2026-003A, SHP-2026-003B) match invoice INV-2026-003; shipment attribution remains unresolved.
assumptions: Receipt POD-REC-003 covers one of the two dispatches but lacks an explicit shipment identifier.
limitations: Deterministic matcher cannot arbitrarily select between two equally plausible shipments without an explicit shipment reference.
expected_findings.next_step: Request explicit consignment note or lorry receipt number linking receipt POD-REC-003 to either SHP-2026-003A or SHP-2026-003B.

must_not_claim: Shipment SHP-2026-003A is the confirmed match merely because its date is closer.
A single shipment match is verified.
